apps.localizedDescription:
Apps2Samsung installs Jellyfin and other web and community apps onto your Samsung Tizen TV — no PC, no Tizen Studio, and no manual sideloading.

This is the mobile (phone) installer head of Apps2Samsung. Put your TV into Developer Mode, point the app at it over your local network, sign in once with a free Samsung account to provision a signing certificate, and install.

Features:

* Finds Samsung Tizen TVs on your network, or connect directly by IP.
* Installs Jellyfin (multiple build variants) and a catalog of community apps.
* Give any app a custom launcher icon and a custom title.
* Optional Jellyfin server pre-configuration: server URL, auto-login, and custom CSS.
* Uses a free Samsung account certificate — no paid developer account required.

Requirements:

* A Samsung Tizen TV in Developer Mode, on the same local network as your phone.

Desktop versions for Windows, macOS and Linux are also available. Apps2Samsung is free and open source (MIT).

versions.localizedDescription:
# Apps2Samsung 3.1

The first update after 3.0: a fix for the Android app hanging at launch on some phones, a better update flow and sorting in **On the TV**, and clearer messages when arming TV-Store.

## ✨ Highlights

### 🤖 Android: no more hang at launch
On phones with animations switched off (Developer options › Animator duration scale, or Samsung's "Remove animations"), every 3.x build froze within seconds and Android reported "Apps2Samsung isn't responding". The TV card's busy light was the cause: with animations off, each fade finished instantly and the pulse loop never let go of the screen. It now keeps its rhythm whether or not the phone animates. (#899)

### 🔄 On the TV: Update opens the app
**Update** on an installed app now opens that app's sheet, with **Update on {TV}** as the button and the version the TV runs underneath. Before, it only switched to the Install tab, and on Android the request got lost on the way. Installed apps that are in the catalog get a **View in catalog** row. (#888)

### ↕️ On the TV: sort it your way
Sort by **Size**, **Name** or **Newest installed** from the ⋯ menu, on Android, iPhone and desktop. Apps with an update available always come first, whichever order you pick, and the choice is remembered. (#888)

### 📺 Arm TV-Store: honest messages
When the TV can't be reached while arming, Apps2Samsung now says so and points at Developer Mode, instead of claiming TV-Store isn't installed and sending you to the catalog. A TV that still has the old TV-Store from before 0.3.5 is told to update it. The arming texts now spell out the Host PC IP order: this device's IP while arming, then the TV's own address. (#889)

### 🐞 Easier bug reports
One bug report form for every platform, with the log steps for the platform you pick, and automatic labels for the platform and Tizen version.

## 📥 Downloads
